view.sqlSentence: SELECT DAY(invoice.issue_date), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE product.id = item.product AND invoice_detail.item = item.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = ? AND YEAR(invoice.issue_date) = ? AND MONTH(invoice.issue_date) = ? GROUP BY 1
